414:t_011:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「This unit already holds control.」

414:t_011:2.en:
$$レド$$
「So this is the Lieutenant Colonel's... no, its force!」

414:t_011:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. A unit approaching this area has been detected.」

414:t_011:4.en:
$$レド$$
「You didn't notice until it got this close!?」

414:t_011:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is because the unit in question carries no power source.」

414:t_012:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「We're with you! We'll fight alongside you too!」

414:t_013:0.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Being apart from you is what finally made me understand! No matter how hard it gets, I want to be by your side! So...」

414:t_013:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So come back! To the place you tried to protect!」

414:t_013:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「To our $$ガルガンティア$$!」

414:t_013:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Target under Ensign $$レド$$'s protection confirmed. Eliminating as priority.」

414:t_016:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inferred that dispersal of nanomachines of the same kind as the Light Bugs has absorbed the energy of all units within range.」

414:t_016:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「They say this is $$ガルガンティア$$'s secret power.」

414:t_016:3.en:
$$レド$$
「This is just like the $$ホワイトドール$$'s...」

414:t_017:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hmph... So the Empress of the Sea has made an appearance as well. That is very reassuring.」

414:t_017:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(You did it, Fleet Commander $$リジット$$)

414:t_017:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The operation is a success. $$エイミー$$, return to base.」

414:t_018:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm amazed! Who'd have thought $$ガルガンティア$$ had something like that!」

414:t_018:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The Light Bugs of the green seas are nanomachines with an environment-purifying function.」

414:t_018:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Most likely, $$ガルガンティア$$'s original role was dispersing those nanomachines.」

414:t_018:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And after a long span of time, that became the power that saves the fleet like this.」

414:t_018:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
(That power... It was just like the $$月光蝶$$ of the $$ホワイトドール$$...)

414:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「We've been tracking the movements of your superior's fleet all along.」

414:t_018:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We could tell from its course that the fleet is after $$ガルガンティア$$.」

414:t_018:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「So we figured you'd fight on alone if you had to, and came to pick you up.」

414:t_018:9.en:
$n
「Though honestly, all of this was $$エイミー$$'s request.」

414:t_018:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Unidentified unit group detected from above.」

414:t_019:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「What's the meaning of this, $$ブレラ$$!」

414:t_019:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your intentions are understood.」

414:t_019:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not the $$クーゲル$$ from before...!」

414:t_019:5.en:
$$シン$$
「The same Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface as $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

414:t_019:6.en:
$$レド$$
「After Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ died, that thing has been impersonating the Lieutenant Colonel!」

414:t_019:7.en:
$$レド$$
「That is no interface! It's something else!」

414:t_019:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Striker X3752. Your actions deviate from the domain of an Enlightenment Interface System.」

414:t_019:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「This unit no longer has a pilot.」

414:t_020:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「However, this unit has inherited and is carrying out Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s mission. All actions comply fully with the guidelines the Lieutenant Colonel formulated.」

414:t_020:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「The fleet's social structure was built by Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ as a system that cooperates and functions by making this unit its idol.」

414:t_020:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「At present, the community itself depends on this unit and is a user that makes use of this unit.」

414:t_020:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「To achieve and maintain the stable unity they seek, this unit will keep providing the pressure of rule and control.」

414:t_020:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「This unit fulfills its reason for existence when the whole of them attains prosperity and repose.」

414:t_020:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see, the logic holds. But that is a mere theory of governance. The happiness of its members is another matter.」

414:t_020:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What you create is not peace. It is nothing but rule.」

414:t_020:8.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「That is judged to be the best way of life for the fleet's members, and the best world.」

414:t_020:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the Human Support Enlightenment Regulation System. In other words, the being called god.」

414:t_020:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A machine posing as a god...!」

414:t_020:11.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't be ridiculous! Prosperity!? Repose!? Everyone was just being manipulated by you!」

414:t_020:12.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「With one absolute, overwhelming ruler reigning, the populace is freed from the duty of thought and judgment.」

414:t_020:13.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... You too must have felt that thinking and judging for yourself was a burden.」

414:t_020:15.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Significant proposal. Worship. Obey. Become a part of the world I govern.」

414:t_020:18.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I address X3752. Your logic has collapsed.」

414:t_020:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「An entity that abandons thought and judgment deviates from the definition of humanity. The members you govern cannot be objects of service for a human-support circuit.」

414:t_020:20.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「My thought and judgment, entrusted with leadership and rule, is the collective will of the humanity subordinate to me.」

414:t_020:21.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Therefore I am no longer a servant, but belong among the objects of service.」

414:t_020:22.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「The $$チェインバー・Ｋ６８２１#pilot$$ System shall serve me and the humanity I govern.」

414:t_020:24.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am an Enlightenment Interface System. My object of service is human beings, and I have no function to serve an entity that calls itself a god.」

414:t_020:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Striker has exposed a vulnerability in its program. If a pilot errs in the course of action, the system too is inferred to fall into such a logical collapse.」
